subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared cross-channel group admission contract, and should pending read-only observation be part of that contract or a separate opt-in mode?
rationale: Source inspection proves the capability is missing, but code review cannot choose the authorization owner, notification route, persistence model, destructive reject/leave behavior, or untrusted-content isolation policy safely.

options.title: Approve Shared Group Admission
options.body: Design one additive contract for pending group approvals, owner notifications, and approve/reject operations, while keeping reader-agent observation separately gated until its isolation rules are settled.

options.title: Limit To Channel-Specific Hardening
options.body: Continue with narrower Telegram warn/leave and WhatsApp auto-leave work and leave cross-channel group pairing unscheduled for now.

options.title: Approve Notification Only
options.body: Add group-add owner notification and audit logging without pending approval state or reader-agent routing.

recommendation.title: Approve Shared Group Admission
recommendation.body: Design one additive contract for pending group approvals, owner notifications, and approve/reject operations, while keeping reader-agent observation separately gated until its isolation rules are settled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and has adjacent security/config history around keeping DM pairing and group authorization separate.
